title: Automatically preload deeper 1D/4H history for the visible chart
changes: Keep the original safe first requests for all symbols (1D 95 and 4H 130) to avoid increasing the startup 33-symbol API load.
Immediately after the active chart becomes ready, automatically extend 1D history to at least 390 bars or the earliest Pionex candle.
Immediately after a 4H chart becomes ready, automatically extend to at least 1000 bars or the earliest Pionex candle.
Preload ONLY the frontmost visible chart and serialize extra requests with a minimum 3.2 second gap.
Reuses existing v2.1.30 Pionex history paging, deep IndexedDB/R2 caching and shared HTTP 429 cooldown; no duplicate exchange request transport.
Stop preloading when real oldest Pionex history is reached; retain prior bars and support continued user-driven panning beyond the warmup target.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite the three files on GitHub Pages. Existing Cloudflare Worker must support /api/monitor/klines endTime as supplied with v2.1.29.
validationNote: Browser test can verify JS warmup behavior with simulated data; real Pionex data availability and 429 recovery need live production verification.
